subject: Novasphere: request for selective log preservation & supporting artifacts
messages:
From: Anika Desai <anika.desai@novasphere.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: privacy@novasphere.com
Date: 2026-09-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: preserve tenant logs for targeted accounts (Novasphere legal hold)

Hi Mateo,

Quick context: Legal has initiated a targeted hold for three customer tenants tied to an ongoing compliance review. They need us to preserve inference request/response logs and debug traces for those tenant IDs for an extra 120 days beyond our standard 90d TTL.

Can Redwood accept a scoped exception for those tenant IDs and provide the following evidence so we can sign it off with our audit team?
- Confirmation of retention window and affected storage locations
- Exportable proof-of-copy (manifest) showing the preserved objects
- A signed statement describing what data fields will be retained and for how long

We appreciate a short turnaround (within 72 hours) — legal is on a tight timeline. I attached a short request sheet with tenant IDs.

Thanks,
Anika Desai
Privacy & Compliance Lead
Novasphere Health
[Attachment: novasphere_req_sheet.pdf (application/pdf, 24KB)]

From: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
To: Anika Desai <anika.desai@novasphere.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: preserve tenant logs for targeted accounts (Novasphere legal hold)

Anika — thanks for the context and the request sheet. I've looped in Kim (Compliance) and Marissa (Security engineering). We can evaluate a scoped preservation, but we need to confirm:
1) Exact tenant IDs and whether this is across hosted + dedicated deployments or just your hosted workloads.
2) The retention scope (full raw traces vs. redacted metadata only).
3) Any downstream export/hand-off expectations (e.g., secure bucket, keystore requirements).

Internally we'll validate storage location, estimated cost delta, and proof artifacts we can produce (manifest + signed attestation). I expect to have an initial answer and a proposed artifact list within 48 hours. If legal needs a formal letter, we can prepare a short attestation.

Matt (Mateo)
Senior Account Lead | Redwood Inference

---
On 2026-09-19 at 09:14 Anika Desai wrote:
> Quick context: Legal has initiated...

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-20T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Novasphere preservation request — artifact plan

Team — I pulled the preservation playbook and spoke to SRE. High-level plan:
- Scope: Hosted-only for tenants listed in the attached sheet; not applicable to Dedicated clusters unless Novasphere confirms dedicated usage.
- Retention change: Add a tenant-scoped override to the TTL policy for the listed tenant IDs to 210 days total (90 standard + 120 extra).
- Proof artifacts we can generate in the 48-hour window:
  * Storage manifest (object keys + timestamps) exported to a signed XLSX (redwood_evidence_manifest.xlsx).
  * Snapshot checksum file for preserved bundles.
  * A brief signed attestation on Redwood letterhead describing data fields preserved (requests, timestamps, request-id, and hashed user identifiers) and the retention window.
- Controls: preserved logs will be stored in an encrypted, access-restricted bucket with KMS keys scoped to Redwood's compliance key ring. Access will be limited to a named SRE/Compliance group; we can include Novasphere auditors as read-only principals for the duration.

Open items for Novasphere to confirm: hosted-only vs hosted+dedicated; whether any customer PII fields should be redacted before preservation; and acceptance of a Redwood-signed attestation instead of a formal contract amendment.

I've attached the draft manifest template and a one-page attestation draft we can finalize after Novasphere confirms scope. If they accept hosted-only and the redaction approach, engineering can flip the override and deliver artifacts within 48 hours.

Kim Park
Director, Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_evidence_manifest.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 12KB)]

From: Anika Desai <anika.desai@novasphere.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: privacy@novasphere.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novasphere preservation request — artifact plan

Hi Mateo / Kim — thanks, that plan aligns with what Legal needs. Confirming: hosted-only, tenant IDs in the attachment, and Novasphere asks that PII fields be redacted (we'll provide a short spec of fields to remove). We are okay with Redwood's attestation in place of a contract amendment for this scoped preservation.

Please proceed with the TTL override to 210 days for the listed tenants and deliver the manifest + checksum + attestation to our secure drive link. Legal requests the artifacts be delivered with a signed PDF attestation and the manifest in XLSX.

If you can deliver within 48 hours that would be ideal. I've copied privacy@novasphere.com for record.

Best,
Anika
Privacy & Compliance Lead
Novasphere Health
